item.title: Mystery Model 'Ox Alpha' Ends DeepSeek's Streak on OpenCode, Stoking a Creator Hunt

item.title: Chang'e-7 Postponement Signals China's Push Toward a Unified Long-Term Lunar Strategy
item.description: China Manned Space Agency said Chang'e-7 does not meet launch conditions for this year's window; the postponement points to a deeper shift toward integrating manned and unmanned lunar plans for long-term presence.

item.title: World Humanoid Robot Games 2.0: Robots Move From Fast Times to Real-World Work
item.description: The second World Humanoid Robot Games wrapped at Beijing's Ice Ribbon with 666 teams and 2,056 robots in 51 events, shifting from raw speed toward dexterous, autonomous and real-scenario work.
